messages.subject: Hale v Wexford Holdings - ET1 (claim 2204187/2025)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Gallagher,

By way of service, the Tribunal has accepted Mr Hale's claim (case number 2204187/2025, London Central). The ET1 pleads unfair dismissal and direct age discrimination. ACAS early conciliation concluded without resolution.

We remain willing to negotiate in parallel and will revert to your without prejudice proposal shortly. The response is due in 28 days.

Regards,
Eleanor Bartlett
Partner
Ashworth Quinn LLP
60 Gracechurch Street, London EC3V 0HR
